claims.claim_text_zh: 多字段残差驱动的 Adaptive CFG 在 256-seed 正式实验中使 E-hull、Stable 和 NUS 呈总体正向改善。
claims.claim_text_en: Multi-field residual-driven Adaptive CFG showed overall positive trends in E-hull, Stable, and NUS in the formal 256-seed experiment.
claims.required_limitation: Paired statistical tests were not significant; MatterSim-5M surrogate only.

claims.claim_text_zh: Learned-Gated E3-PCR 在独立 256-seed 实验中将预松弛最大力降低 23.28%，同时主要 MatterSim 代理质量指标保持不变。
claims.claim_text_en: Learned-Gated E3-PCR reduced pre-relaxation maximum force by 23.28% in an independent 256-seed experiment while preserving the main MatterSim surrogate quality metrics.
claims.required_limitation: MatterSim-5M surrogate evaluation; no DFT verification.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: DFT-verified or experimentally verified material stability.

claims.claim_text_zh: Learned Gate 以更低覆盖率减少有害修改和低初始力结构恶化，同时保留大部分最大力改善收益。
claims.claim_text_en: The Learned Gate reduced harmful interventions and low-force degradation at lower coverage while retaining most maximum-force gain.
claims.required_limitation: Always-on has the larger average force reduction; gating does not guarantee per-structure safety.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: The gate always improves every structure or beats Always-on in mean force reduction.

claims.claim_text_zh: 第一组独立组合验证中 A0+E3-G 将最大力降低 27.10%。
claims.claim_text_en: A0+E3-G reduced maximum force by 27.10% in the first independent combination cohort.

claims.claim_text_zh: 第二组完全独立 64-seed 组合复现中 A0+E3-G 将最大力降低 19.02%。
claims.claim_text_en: A0+E3-G reduced maximum force by 19.02% in the second fully independent 64-seed replication.
claims.required_limitation: Report separately from cohort 1; effect sizes differ.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Hide cohort heterogeneity or pool as a preregistered 128-seed study.

claims.claim_text_zh: 训练重叠没有明显夸大平均最大力改善，但显著高估 Gate 安全性。
claims.claim_text_en: Training overlap did not clearly inflate mean maximum-force improvement but significantly inflated apparent gate safety.
claims.required_limitation: Diagnostic only; mixed cohort invalid for independent claims.
claims.forbidden_overclaim: Independent validation based on the mixed or training-overlap cohort.
